required_behaviors.PSL01: Accepted unpersisted negative facts survive ordinary reads and partial refresh; only exact fresh materialization and successful release can restore the affected plugin.
required_behaviors.PSL02: Panic/inherited unknown remains fail closed through ordinary reads and forbids prior-record fallback on recovery.
required_behaviors.PSL03: Healthy local refresh, clean fenced/disposed work and known failed reservation preserve existing cached availability; ordinary readers do not wait on a paused exclusive writer.
required_behaviors.PSL04: Actual refresh work owns the process lease through loader, publication and cleanup. Terminal work releases it while readers remain; obsolete guards cannot unlock a successor.
required_behaviors.PSL05: Known healthy negative outcomes settle their intent; identical refresh token churn is not reported as another change. Existing durable error categories and cache-before-release barriers remain.
required_behaviors.PSL06: Explicit writers may durably create their permitted missing directory chain; constructors and pure image loads remain side-effect-free. Contention uses the pinned fs2 platform sentinel.
required_behaviors.PSL07: A retained initialized owner never treats total custody-file loss as legacy absence. It retains confirmed/pending/auth facts, latches recovery fault, refuses read/mutation/refresh before remote work or state reinitialization, and stays faulted after explicit restoration; a fresh owner may inspect the restored image.
required_behaviors.PSL08: Every actual uninstall reservation, exact settlement and confirmed-fact release rotates required nullable canonical v3 uninstallObservation. Auth/refresh-only transitions preserve it. A foreign complete cycle cannot republish a pre-cycle result even if all semantic sets return identical; pruning binds the successful pass's post-commit identity.
required_behaviors.PSL09: Workflow mutation selects a canonical plugin, acquires its actual SH lease, then re-reads the committed record and current publisher authority. Changed, removed or remapped records and unknown/different publishers refuse before touching either prior or current file; an unchanged current publisher can edit.
required_behaviors.PSL10: An image integrity error observed under authoritative SH latches owner-local recovery, preserves known facts and advances local observation. Restoration cannot heal that retained owner. Unlocked contended reads may deny only the current observation; a fresh owner may inspect explicit repair.
required_behaviors.PSL11: The actual upload mutation lease covers backend and cleanup I/O, then ends before either cleanup log or edge diagnostic callback. Reentrant callbacks can acquire actual EX and sync the real owner; original backend success/error and diagnostic emission remain.
